clauses.scope_note: Applies to the licensee's modified version of the AGPL Program when it supports remote interaction over a computer network and users interact with it remotely. Requires an offer to all such users, not operation of a network service as such. Source access must be from a network server at no charge using standard or customary copying means; where a GPLv3-covered work is incorporated under the following paragraph, its Corresponding Source is included.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_modified_program means the licensee modified the Program. modified_version_supports_remote_network_interaction means that version supports interaction through a computer network. users_interact_remotely means users interact with that version remotely. The final any condition means either no GPLv3-covered work is incorporated under the following paragraph, or its Corresponding Source must be included.

clauses.scope_note: Express permission to link or combine an AGPL-covered work with a GPLv3-licensed work into a single combined work and convey that resulting work. The AGPL continues to govern the covered part; GPLv3 continues to govern the work combined with it. This does not state that either license governs the other part.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission applies only when the combination is of an AGPL-covered work and a work licensed under GPLv3, produces a single combined work, and preserves the specified license scope for each part.

clauses.scope_note: Choice of the AGPL version whose terms to follow for the Program. If the Program specifies a numbered version or any later version, the choice is that version or a later FSF-published version. If no version is specified, the choice may be any version ever published by the FSF.
clauses.condition_explanation: program_specifies_numbered_agpl_version means the Program identifies a numbered AGPL version; program_specifies_or_any_later_version means its designation also permits later versions. program_does_not_specify_agpl_version means no AGPL version number is specified. chosen_version_is_specified_version_or_later_fsf_published_version and chosen_version_published_by_fsf constrain the selected version as stated.

clauses.scope_note: For a Program whose terms specify that a proxy may decide which future AGPL versions can be used, the proxy's public acceptance of a version permanently authorizes the licensee to choose that version for the Program.
clauses.condition_explanation: program_specifies_proxy_may_decide_future_versions means the Program names a proxy as having that decision authority. proxy_publicly_accepts_version means the proxy makes a public statement accepting a version. chosen_version_is_accepted_version means the licensee chooses that accepted version.

clauses.scope_note: A later license version may provide additional or different permissions; choosing it imposes no additional obligations on an author or copyright holder as a result of that choice. The text does not specify the contents of any later version's permissions.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_chooses_to_follow_later_agpl_version means the licensee elects to follow a later AGPL version. The predicate preserves that the later version may change permissions while the choice itself adds no obligations to authors or copyright holders.

coverage_audit.explanation: Models the modified-version and remote-interaction trigger, all interacting users, prominent offer, no-charge network-server access, customary copying means, and incorporated GPLv3 Corresponding Source inclusion. Does not turn the clause into a duty to operate a network service.
Models the scoped permission to link or combine AGPL-covered and GPLv3-licensed works into one combined work and convey it, while retaining each license's scope over its respective part.
Models the alternatives for a specified version, unspecified version, and proxy acceptance, plus the stated possible later-version permissions and no-additional-obligations rule.
